name: East-facing short roof light behind the garden hip
registration: Use projection('sina-35') in the local metre frame. The 35-to-38 image transfer and its limited baseline are described in east-return-photo-control.json.
observed_surface_at_intersection: The lower edge of the light plaster cheek runs into the tiled slope. Intersecting the four rays with the preceding whole-building roof yields normalized (u,d,z).
limits: The roof intersection and two visible faces constrain the model. The tree masks the glass sill, last light and rear cheek. The short depth and simple rear closure are approximate. These two exposures share almost the same direction.
surface_check_notes: Re-inspection of 35 in its larger rendition showed the earlier proposed cheek samples (514,92) and (522,97) fall on foreground branches over the sloping tile line. The separate roof-dormer-photo-pixels.json keeps these two initial observations for traceability. In the following surface controls the plain plaster patches were confirmed on the original source before testing.
